基本的な計測例

#!/usr/bin/env python
import sys
import time
from aandd_reader import AanddReader
from x_logger import XLogger


if __name__ == "__main__":

    log_mode = "file"
    logger = XLogger(
        log_level="info",
        log_mode=log_mode,
        log_name="aandd.log",
        logger_name="aandd_reader",
    )

    # COMポートを選ぶ
    # aandd_reader = AanddReader(port="COM4", logger=logger)
    aandd_reader = AanddReader(port="COM3", logger=logger)

    # Reset
    aandd_reader.reset()
    time.sleep(0.5)
    
    # 測定
    ret = aandd_reader.meas()
    if ret is False:
        logger.error("Error measuring.")
        logger.error(ret)
        sys.exit(1)
        
    logger.info(ret)
